About this item

  • 【Big & Tall Heavy-Duty Comfort】This comfy gaming chair features upgraded wider and taller frame designed for adults up to 6'3" and 350 lbs. Provides spacious ergonomic support for long gaming sessions, office work, bedroom rest, and studying
  • 【90°-125° Recline with Footrest & Linked Armrests】 This gaming chair with footrest offers a smooth 90° to 125° reclining backrest, plus synchronized linkage armrests that move along with you. Maintains stable shoulder and arm support from upright work to full lounging
  • 【High-Density Foam – Soft Yet Supportive】Thick high-density resilient foam gives this computer chair a perfect balance of sofa-like softness and firm body support. This comfy chair relieves hip and thigh pressure, prevents all-day fatigue, and keeps its shape over time
  • 【Breathable Linen Upholstery】Open‑weave linen boosts airflow to avoid heat buildup. Stay dry and non‑sticky even during extended sitting, with tough abrasion resistance for daily heavy‑use scenarios
  • 【Stable Base & Quick Assembly】Heavy-duty metal base with silent smooth-rolling casters supports up to 350 lbs. Complete tools and manual included for fast, simple assembly in about 25 minutes.
  • 【FSC-Certified】 Chair cushion inner support of the chair is made of FSC-Certified wood

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    High quality gaming chair
    Reviewed in the United States on April 9, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This chair is a replacement for another gaming chair I had for a number of years that had the fake leather on it and tore off over time, so I decided to get one with a cloth cover instead. I'm happy with the quality of the chair and it looks like it will hold up well over time. It also looks really good.

    One thing to be aware of is that the chair seat is very firm. If you want a chair that is softer, this is probably not the best option for you. It is still comfortable and I'd still recommend it for anyone who doesn't mind a more firm seat.

    Another thing to be aware of is that the width of the back between the raised sides is rather narrow. If you have broad shoulders or are a bigger person, you may not be able to lean back comfortably in the chair.

    The chair can be put together pretty easily by one person and the only issue I had was the picture for attaching the seat back to the seat... the bar that attaches is shown in the picture backwards from what it is supposed to be. If you watch the video that they provide, it's clear how to attach it, but if you're following the instruction images, it may be confusing.

    The reclining lever is the type that you can push or pull and let go while adjusting the back rather than the spring ones where you have to hold it while adjusting the back. Either option is fine, but I find this style to be slightly more convenient.

    The best economy chair
    Reviewed in the United States on August 5, 2026
    Color: 01 Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    Probably the best economy chair on the market.

    I needed a second chair for guests and didn't want to spend for another SL chair. This one is surprising well made for the price.

    Pros:

    Metal frame. Definitely better than cheaper plastic options. Solid build.

    Easy assembly. I was able to put it together by myself in about 35 minutes.

    Material. Reminds me a bit of car seat material. Decently soft and seems fine for prolonged sitting.

    Cons.

    Leg rest is really short. Basically useless and I'm only 5'8, BUT it's a standard size and can be replaced with an alternative.

    Lumbar pillow is not attached. Also kind useless.

    Arm rests. Not adjustable. But they do move with the recline.

    Overall, I got it for $100 and worth every penny.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Comfortable, Sturdy, Stylish!
    Reviewed in the United States on December 11, 2024
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is my first ever gaming chair and it makes a great first impression. As the title says, it's comfortable, it's sturdy, and the black and grey color combo looks really nice.

    the packaging was compact, the instructions were very easy to follow as everything is coded with numbers and letters to show where each hardware piece belongs to what part and how to install it properly.

    The foot rest is not necessarily a foot rest, it's more for your calves ( I'm 5'9")

    The assembly took me roughly 30-45 minutes. Only complaint I have with it is assembling the arm rests, while yes they flex to adjust to the backrest, screwing them in can be tedious since the screws sometimes jump out and make you start over again. I suggest having a second person help out with the arm rests by pressing them into the chair while the other person screws the hardware in.

    otherwise, i've had this chair for now roughly 2 weeks and it feels great. it's helped with my back pain a bit from my old lounger chair.

    i highly recommend also to vacuum the fabric before assembly, and give everything a nice disinfectant spray before sitting down on it; let the spray sit for a few hours / a day. As with most warehouse items / packaged items, this will come with a smell. I used the Febreeze disinfectant / odor eliminator spray on everything as i assembled it, then gave it a nice vacuum clean. no more smell!

    if you're looking for a first time gaming chair, or a low-cost, good quality gaming chair, or even a gift for your grandkids, kids, nephew, niece, etc. this is a good buy for them.

    There's also no noise or squeaking when spinning around in it or moving it around on the wheels. Very smooth motion!

About this Item

  • 【Big & Tall Heavy-Duty Comfort】This comfy gaming chair features upgraded wider and taller frame designed for adults up to 6'3" and 350 lbs. Provides spacious ergonomic support for long gaming sessions, office work, bedroom rest, and studying
  • 【90°-125° Recline with Footrest & Linked Armrests】 This gaming chair with footrest offers a smooth 90° to 125° reclining backrest, plus synchronized linkage armrests that move along with you. Maintains stable shoulder and arm support from upright work to full lounging
  • 【High-Density Foam – Soft Yet Supportive】Thick high-density resilient foam gives this computer chair a perfect balance of sofa-like softness and firm body support. This comfy chair relieves hip and thigh pressure, prevents all-day fatigue, and keeps its shape over time
  • 【Breathable Linen Upholstery】Open‑weave linen boosts airflow to avoid heat buildup. Stay dry and non‑sticky even during extended sitting, with tough abrasion resistance for daily heavy‑use scenarios
  • 【Stable Base & Quick Assembly】Heavy-duty metal base with silent smooth-rolling casters supports up to 350 lbs. Complete tools and manual included for fast, simple assembly in about 25 minutes.
  • 【FSC-Certified】 Chair cushion inner support of the chair is made of FSC-Certified wood

Product Description

This GTPLAYER Big & Tall ergonomic seating features a wider higher frame for adults up to 6’3” & 350 lbs. With 90°-125° adjustable recline, linked armrests and soft high-density memory foam padding, it delivers all-day comfort for gaming, home relaxation, office working and daily studying. Available in linen, PU leather, tech cloth and velvet upholstery, paired with stable heavy-duty base and easy assembly design.
